snippet.title: Runix: Pinball Roguelike Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Runix: Pinball Roguelike steam page is available now! 

Wishlist it now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617290/Runix_Pinball_Roguelike

Do you like pinball games or Roguelikes? You will definetly love this one! In this pinball game you will need to defeat monsters, build your ball deck to create powerfull combos and advance through your journey to be the most powerfull pinball wizzard!


#videogames #indiegames #steam #pinball #roguelike #wishlist #english #videogames #announcement
